eventSheet.triggerDescription: User opens the app for the first time after installation
eventSheet.reason: New user acquisition baseline

eventSheet.triggerDescription: New user enters the onboarding flow on first launch
eventSheet.reason: Onboarding funnel entry signal

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User finishes all onboarding steps successfully
eventSheet.reason: Measures onboarding completion rate

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps Skip during onboarding, exiting before completion
eventSheet.reason: Identifies onboarding drop-off step

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps Play to begin a puzzle level
eventSheet.reason: Core gameplay funnel entry event

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User correctly solves a puzzle level
eventSheet.reason: Primary retention and progression signal

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User exhausts all attempts without solving the level
eventSheet.reason: Flags difficulty spikes and churn risk

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps Restart during an active level attempt
eventSheet.reason: Signals frustration or deliberate replay

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps the Hint button inside a puzzle level
eventSheet.reason: Tracks hint consumption and monetization triggers

eventSheet.triggerDescription: A new chapter becomes accessible to the user
eventSheet.reason: Measures depth of progression through content

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User enters and begins the daily brain challenge
eventSheet.reason: Core daily engagement loop event

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User successfully finishes the daily challenge puzzle
eventSheet.reason: Daily retention and streak health signal

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User hits a notable streak threshold (7 / 14 / 30 / 60 days)
eventSheet.reason: Trigger for celebration moments and loyalty rewards

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User successfully completes a hint pack purchase
eventSheet.reason: Consumable revenue event for hints

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps any Buy or Purchase CTA in the app
eventSheet.reason: First step of the IAP purchase funnel

eventSheet.triggerDescription: App store confirms a successful in-app purchase
eventSheet.reason: Core revenue event — used for LTV and ROAS

eventSheet.triggerDescription: Purchase attempt ends in failure, error, or cancellation
eventSheet.reason: Identifies payment friction and lost revenue

eventSheet.triggerDescription: An ad unit renders and is displayed to the user
eventSheet.reason: Monitors ad fill rate and exposure frequency

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps on a displayed advertisement
eventSheet.reason: Tracks ad CTR by placement and format

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User watches a rewarded video ad to completion
eventSheet.reason: Triggers reward delivery and measures ad engagement

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps the Share button on a result or score screen
eventSheet.reason: First step of the viral sharing funnel

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User successfully shares content to an external platform
eventSheet.reason: Measures virality and organic reach

eventSheet.triggerDescription: In-app store rating dialog is displayed to the user
eventSheet.reason: Tracks prompt timing and frequency

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User submits a star rating via the in-app prompt
eventSheet.reason: Store rating signal and NPS proxy

eventSheet.triggerDescription: OS-level push permission dialog is shown to the user
eventSheet.reason: Critical for measuring opt-in funnel

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps Allow on the push notification permission dialog
eventSheet.reason: Determines reachable push audience size

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User taps Deny on the push notification permission dialog
eventSheet.reason: Identifies users unreachable via push

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User opens the Settings screen from any surface
eventSheet.reason: Feature discoverability and UX usage

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User turns sound effects or background music on or off
eventSheet.reason: Audio preference signal for personalisation

eventSheet.triggerDescription: User selects a different display language in the app
eventSheet.reason: Localisation insight and market segmentation

eventSheet.reason: Measures passive discovery behavior

eventSheet.reason: Measures DM engagement and inbox activity

eventSheet.reason: Measures opt-out risk and notification preference shifts
